AGIBOT X2
Sale price
$24,240.00 USD
AGIBOT X2 is a half-size humanoid robot engineered for the entertainment and commercial performance sector. It supports a wide variety of full-body motion transitions and possesses a rich set of motion skills and preset motions, offering exceptional cost-effectiveness. It features powerful multimodal capabilities in multimodal, proactive, and customizable interaction. Furthermore, its construction incorporates a flexible material shell and a compact,lightweight structure to ensure safety and reliability.

Frequently Asked Questions
Here you’ll find answers to the most frequently asked questions, helping you better understand AGIBOT’s products and services.
sales@agibot.com
No.2555, Xiupu Road, Kangqiao Business Oasis,
Caohejing, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.
Will the AGIBOT X2 series "crash into walls" during navigation in complex environments?
Without the advanced autonomous driving function package, the robot does not have autonomous movement and navigation capabilities. With the advanced package selected, the robot will not crash into walls within the ODD (Optical Design Domain) requirements.
Is its "vital signs" its head? Can it really "express emotions"?
The robot has built-in basic emotions, expressing them through actions, sounds, and facial expressions. These will be continuously upgraded via OTA updates. With the optional advanced interaction package and combined with a multimodal large model, its vital sign expression will be even richer and more dynamic.
How long is the battery life? Will it automatically find a charging station when the battery is low?
This function is supported when the optional charging station and advanced self-driving function package are selected.
In case of malfunction, is repair convenient? Is return and exchange supported?
Modular design supports convenient repair and replacement.
No return or exchange within 7 days is not supported (due to the customized nature of the product).
How is technical support guaranteed? How are problems resolved?
Self-service Support:Problems can be resolved independently through technical documentation, development guides, and self-checks.
Manual Support:Only hardware warranty is provided. Technical issues must be resolved by the user. Please carefully read and confirm the "Technical Capability Confirmation Agreement" before placing an order to ensure it meets your own technical requirements.
Emergency Issues:Immediately disconnect power and contact after-sales service. Data security is the user's responsibility.
What is "Silicon Photonics Voice"?
A multimodal interaction model based on a deeply customized and optimized fundamental large model.
